metadata.description: Skills and mods for Claude Code and claude.ai, published as plugins.

plugins.name: agent-orchestrator
plugins.description: Splits large or multi-part tasks between named subagents and picks each agent's model and effort to match the difficulty of its subtask.

plugins.name: humanizator
plugins.description: Rewrites English or Polish text to remove AI-isms: scores it with a weighted lexicon, templates, Markdown, rhythm and Polish typography, rewrites in the author's voice in two passes and guards the facts.

plugins.name: slopperoinator
plugins.description: Generates deliberately AI-sounding English or Polish text for parody, training and test data, with slop-density knobs, model personas and an amplifier that hits a target AI-smell score.

plugins.name: shorterinator
plugins.description: Turns routines the AI repeats step by step into scripts it runs in one call: analyses the project, proposes what to script, agrees success criteria with the user, tests the script and registers it for later sessions.
